news.title: Broad risk-on reversal snaps Friday's selloff; AI/chip names lead
news.text: Major indices are sharply higher Monday, reversing Friday's steep AI/tech-stock-led selloff (S&P 500 -3.7% Fri, VIX closed 35.89). The VIX has pulled back to the high-20s intraday. Chip and software names are among the biggest gainers on the watchlist (ZS, AAOI, CIEN, NOK, PLTR). A PCE inflation report due Wednesday is being flagged as the next test of whether the bounce holds.

news.title: Caution: unverified "Huang reinstated at Nvidia" headlines contradict Nvidia's own board
news.text: Several search results today describe today's rally as driven by Nvidia "reinstating" Jensen Huang as CEO. That claim does not reconcile: Nvidia's own investor-relations page confirms Huang resigned as CEO, President and a board member on 12 Nov, with CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO, and a separate report quotes new board chair Harvey Jones saying the board "does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO." Dropped from this page per the cross-check rule - flagging here since the claim is circulating.

news.title: Anthropic (ANT) still finding its footing after Thursday's blockbuster IPO debut
news.text: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 and opened at $111.50 on 19 Nov before fading to close day one up 17% at $97.17; data providers showed conflicting quotes near $95-99 on 20 Nov, underscoring thin, volatile price discovery in the first days of trading. Relevant context for Communication Services/Tech sentiment (GOOGL, META on the watchlist) even though ANT itself is not a pick.
